# Generic option instances must not leak across instantiations: a fact for
# Box[int?] restores that variable's Value only; Box[int].Value stays int.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd src
logos build ./...
logos lint ./...
logos run ./cmd
stderr '^0$'
stderr '^nil$'
cd neg
! logos build ./...
stderr 'cannot use'
cd ..

logos eject -o out
exists out/cmd/main.go
cd out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

-- src/go.mod --
module example.com/optgeneric

go 1.27

-- src/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type Box[T any] struct {
	Value T
}

var Optional Box[int?]

var Plain Box[int]

-- src/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/optgeneric/lib"

func main() {
	var n int = lib.Plain.Value
	println(n)
	if lib.Optional.Value == nil {
		println("nil")
	}
}

-- src/neg/go.mod --
module example.com/optgenericneg

go 1.27

require example.com/optgeneric v0.0.0

replace example.com/optgeneric => ..

-- src/neg/neg.lgo --
package neg

import "example.com/optgeneric/lib"

// Optional.Value is optional: assigning it to int must not compile.
var _ int = lib.Optional.Value
